summary: Iter 215bk Member Edit Drawer testing completed. Backend: 15/15 tests pass. Frontend: Drawer opens correctly with all 4 tabs (Profile, Classes, Payments, Family), all form fields present, tab switching works. Minor UI issue: X close button blocked by navbar overlay (z-index issue).

ui_bugs.issue: X close button (member-drawer-close) is blocked by navbar overlay when drawer is scrolled to top. Navbar intercepts pointer events.
ui_bugs.workaround: Click backdrop to close drawer instead

action_items: Consider adding z-index or position adjustment to drawer close button to prevent navbar overlay interception

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all features work, minor close button z-index issue)
